# doppler_project_tag (Resource)

Manage a Doppler tag assigned to a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "doppler_tag" "backend" {
  name = "Backend"
}

resource "doppler_project_tag" "backend" {
  project  = "backend"
  tag_slug = doppler_tag.backend.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The name of the Doppler project the tag is assigned to
- `tag_slug` (String) The slug of the Doppler tag

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import doppler_project_tag.default <project-name>.<tag-slug>
```
